passive.name: Surging Tides
passive.description: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.

primaryAbilities.name: Aqua Prison
primaryAbilities.description: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Nami hurls a bubble, <status>Stunning</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagett }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Ebb and Flow
primaryAbilities.description: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allied and enemy champions, healing allies and damaging enemies.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to {{ maxtargets }} targets.
  • Restores {{ totalheal }} Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion.
  • Deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion.
    The damage and healing value is modified by {{ bouncescaling }} each bounce. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Tidecaller's Blessing
primaryAbilities.description: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Nami empowers an allied champion's next {{ hitcount }} Attacks and Abilities for {{ buffduration }} seconds, causing them to <status>Slow</status> their targets by {{ totalslow }} for {{ slowduration }}s and deal an additional <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Tidal Wave
primaryAbilities.description: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Nami summons a tidal wave, Knocking Up for 0.5 seconds, Slowing by {{ slowamount }}%, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on distance the wave traveled, up to {{ maxslowduration }} seconds.

Allies hit by the wave gain double the effect of Surging Tides.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
